title: Practice 2: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom admired the pearly whiteness of the fabric.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
